_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Dearly Departed#001.src: Ah, looks like a fresh recruit! Did you see my posting? Good, good.
Dearly Departed#001.dst: 아, 신병이구먼! 내 공고 봤나? 좋아, 좋아.
Dearly Departed#001.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#002.src: You see, my dear father-in-law recently passed, and I had to bury him hastily out back. Couldn't get a priest here in time to bury him all properly...
Dearly Departed#002.dst: 실은 사랑하는 장인어른이 얼마 전 돌아가셔서 뒤뜰에 급히 묻었지. 제때 사제를 불러 제대로 모시지 못했어...
Dearly Departed#002.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#003.src: Unfortunately, it so happens that my wedding ring might have slipped off as I was putting him to rest...
Dearly Departed#003.dst: 그런데 공교롭게도 장인어른을 묻다가 결혼반지가 빠진 것 같아...
Dearly Departed#003.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#004.src: I need you to go back there and, well, recover the ring.
Dearly Departed#004.dst: 거기 가서, 음, 반지를 찾아와 줘.
Dearly Departed#004.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#005.src: It's nothing I couldn't handle myself, of course, but the wife already suspects something, and with her dear father passing so recently...
Dearly Departed#005.dst: 물론 나 혼자도 할 수 있지만, 아내가 벌써 뭔가 눈치챘고, 장인어른도 막 돌아가셨으니...
Dearly Departed#005.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#006.src: Well, you see the situation I'm in? Help a poor fellow out, just go and grab that [Muddy Shovel] over there, and then come back to me.
Dearly Departed#006.dst: 내 처지 알겠지? 불쌍한 사람 좀 도와줘. 저기 [Muddy Shovel]을 챙겨서 다시 와 줘.
Dearly Departed#006.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#008.src: The [Muddy Shovel] is just over there. I'd really appreciate the help, recruit.
Dearly Departed#008.dst: [Muddy Shovel]은 바로 저기 있어. 도와주면 정말 고맙겠네, 신병.
Dearly Departed#008.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#010.src: You've got the shovel? Great! You've got some sturdy armour and a weapon too, I presume?
Dearly Departed#010.dst: 삽 챙겼나? 좋아! 튼튼한 방어구랑 무기도 있겠지?
Dearly Departed#010.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#011.src: Good, good. Better safe than sorry... As I always say! Always, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#011.dst: 좋아, 좋아. 조심해서 나쁠 건 없지... 내가 늘 하는 말이야! 늘, 하하...
Dearly Departed#011.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#012.src: Oh, no reason really! Just making sure, ha ha... Should be perfectly safe back there, perfectly safe.
Dearly Departed#012.dst: 아, 별 이유 없어! 그냥 확인이야, 하하... 뒤뜰은 아주 안전할 거야, 아주 안전해.
Dearly Departed#012.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#013.src: You've used your Skill Points too, right? They come in handy, should something happen.
Dearly Departed#013.dst: 스킬 포인트도 썼지? 무슨 일이 생기면 쓸모가 있거든.
Dearly Departed#013.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#014.src: Well, they're Skill Points! You gain them as you level up, then you can assign them to get bonuses in combat. Look, I'm no soldier, but even I know you really should be using them...
Dearly Departed#014.dst: 스킬 포인트잖아! 레벨이 오르면 얻는데, 배분하면 전투에서 보너스를 받아. 난 군인은 아니지만 그건 꼭 써야 한다는 건 알아...
Dearly Departed#014.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#015.src: There's five of them. Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Defence, and Agility, each with different bonuses.
Dearly Departed#015.dst: 다섯 가지야. 힘, 민첩, 지능, 방어, 재빠름. 각각 보너스가 달라.
Dearly Departed#015.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#016.src: You get it, or do you want me to tell you what they are?
Dearly Departed#016.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#017.src: is handy if you're having a tough time taking down enemies. It makes your attacks hit harder, simple as.
Dearly Departed#017.dst: 적을 쓰러뜨리기 힘들 때 유용해. 공격이 더 강해지거든, 간단하지.
Dearly Departed#017.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#018.src: 's a bit of a tricky one. The more of it you've got, the higher the likelihood is that your attacks will deal double damage. Neat, right?
Dearly Departed#018.dst: 조금 까다로워. 많이 찍을수록 공격이 두 배 피해를 줄 확률이 높아져. 괜찮지?
Dearly Departed#018.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#019.src: is for the spellcasters, it lowers the cost to cast spells and increases your max amount of mana.
Dearly Departed#019.dst: 주문을 쓰는 사람용이야. 주문 소모를 줄이고 최대 마나를 늘려 주지.
Dearly Departed#019.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#020.src: is your best bet if you're struggling with staying alive. Decreases the damage you take, 's about all.
Dearly Departed#020.dst: 살아남기 힘들다면 이게 최선이야. 받는 피해를 줄여 줘, 그게 다야.
Dearly Departed#020.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#021.src: Agility, now that one is for the risktakers. The more you have, the likelier you are to dodge incoming attacks, negating most of their damage.
Dearly Departed#021.dst: 재빠름, 이건 모험가 체질용이야. 많을수록 들어오는 공격을 피할 확률이 올라서 피해를 대부분 없애 주지.
Dearly Departed#021.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#022.src: Best part is, you can combine them however you want, no matter your class or style of fighting.
Dearly Departed#022.dst: 제일 좋은 건 직업이나 전투 방식에 상관없이 마음대로 조합할 수 있다는 거야.
Dearly Departed#022.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#023.src: Just open your compass to assign your Skill Points. Then, when you're ready, head in there and get my ring.
Dearly Departed#023.dst: 나침반을 열면 스킬 포인트를 배분할 수 있어. 준비되면 들어가서 내 반지를 찾아 줘.
Dearly Departed#023.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#025.src: Go on then, soldier! Show us the might of {p}'s army! Uh, I mean... get me that ring!
Dearly Departed#025.dst: 어서 가게, 병사! {p} 군대의 위력을 보여 줘! 어, 그러니까... 반지를 찾아와!
Dearly Departed#025.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#026.src: What's going on in there, soldier? Have you found the ring yet?
Dearly Departed#026.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#027.src: You really should hurry, before... nevermind! Just find the ring and get out of there!
Dearly Departed#027.dst: 정말 서두르는 게 좋아, 그 전에... 아니야! 그냥 반지 찾아서 나와!
Dearly Departed#027.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#028.src: Holy Bovine! It's... it's... he's back! Kill it, quickly!
Dearly Departed#028.dst: 맙소사! 저... 저... 그가 돌아왔어! 어서 죽여!
Dearly Departed#028.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#030.src: You did it! Come back here now, so I can finally get my ring back.
Dearly Departed#030.dst: 해냈구먼! 이제 돌아와, 드디어 반지를 되찾겠네.
Dearly Departed#030.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#032.src: Goodness, that was a little more exciting than I anticipated, hmph. Still, good work! I'm glad we were able to get rid of that monster...
Dearly Departed#032.dst: 세상에, 생각보다 좀 짜릿했구먼, 흠. 그래도 잘했어! 그 괴물을 없애서 다행이야...
Dearly Departed#032.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#033.src: I mean... poor father-in-law! I don't know how I'll explain this to the wife...
Dearly Departed#033.dst: 그러니까... 불쌍한 장인어른! 아내한테 이걸 어떻게 설명하지...
Dearly Departed#033.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#034.src: I'll take the ring now, it's rather precious to me...
Dearly Departed#034.dst: 반지는 이제 내가 받지. 나한텐 꽤 소중한 거라...
Dearly Departed#034.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#035.src: Anyhow, take this well-deserved reward for the, well, actions you took today. Perhaps, if you keep it up, you could even become a hero like Ragnar one day.
Dearly Departed#035.dst: 아무튼 오늘 한, 음, 일에 대한 정당한 보상이야. 이대로 계속하면 언젠가 Ragnar 같은 영웅이 될지도 모르지.
Dearly Departed#035.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#036.src: Hello there, stranger. Was there something you wanted to speak to me about?
Dearly Departed#036.dst: 안녕하세요, 낯선 분. 저한테 하실 말씀이라도 있나요?
Dearly Departed#036.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#037.src: I should be angry but... I can't pretend to be surprised. He's always been such a forgetful oaf.
Dearly Departed#037.dst: 화를 내야 하는데... 놀란 척은 못 하겠네요. 원래 그렇게 잘 잊어버리는 멍청이예요.
Dearly Departed#037.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#038.src: But, it explains a lot... He's been acting weird lately, ever since dad passed. That must've been what happened, so thank you for telling me.
Dearly Departed#038.dst: 그래도 이제 이해가 돼요... 아버지 돌아가신 뒤로 이상하게 굴었거든요. 그래서였군요, 알려 줘서 고마워요.
Dearly Departed#038.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#039.src: That's right. The one and only, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#039.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#040.src: We're just simple farmers, trying to get by. We were taking care of my dad until... well... yeah...
Dearly Departed#040.dst: 그냥 먹고살려는 평범한 농부예요. 아버지를 모시고 살았는데... 음... 네...
Dearly Departed#040.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#041.src: Thank you... It all happened so suddenly. On the day I left for {p}, dad was as healthy as ever, but when I came back he was already buried. The sickness must have come so fast...
Dearly Departed#041.dst: 고마워요... 너무 갑자기 일어난 일이라. {p}에 가던 날만 해도 아버지는 정정하셨는데, 돌아와 보니 이미 묻히셨더라고요. 병이 참 빨리 왔나 봐요...
Dearly Departed#041.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#042.src: But at his age, I'm not surprised... It's just regrettable that we couldn't get a priest out here in time, dad was such a pious man.
Dearly Departed#042.dst: 그래도 연세를 생각하면 놀랍진 않아요... 신앙심 깊은 분이셨는데 제때 사제를 못 모신 게 아쉬울 뿐이에요.
Dearly Departed#042.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#043.src: Dad... Above all, he was kind and always generous. He left us this entire farm. And very pious too, a true believer. Maybe that's why he lived so long...
Dearly Departed#043.dst: 아버지는... 무엇보다 다정하고 늘 너그러우셨어요. 이 농장도 통째로 물려주셨죠. 신앙심도 깊으셨고요. 그래서 오래 사셨나 봐요...
Dearly Departed#043.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#044.src: Oh, dear... If I don't stop, I'm gonna start crying again.
Dearly Departed#044.dst: 아, 이런... 그만하지 않으면 또 울 것 같아요.
Dearly Departed#044.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#045.src: You've used your Skill Points too, right? They could come in handy, should something happen.
Dearly Departed#045.dst: 스킬 포인트도 썼지? 무슨 일이 생기면 쓸모가 있을 거야.

Dearly Departed#046.src: There's five of them.  Strength,  Dexterity,  Intelligence,  Defence, and  Agility, each with different bonuses.
Dearly Departed#046.dst: 다섯 가지야.  힘,  민첩,  지능,  방어,  재빠름. 각각 보너스가 달라.

Dearly Departed#047.src: Why are you asking me that?

Dearly Departed#056.src: Now to see if you can find that ring Cevalus mentioned...
Dearly Departed#056.dst: 이제 Cevalus가 말한 반지를 찾을 수 있을지 보자...

Dearly Departed#057.src: You manage to pry the ring off the monster's finger...

Dearly Departed#060.src: {#} Strength is handy if you're having a tough time taking down enemies. It makes your attacks hit harder, simple as.
Dearly Departed#060.dst: {#} 힘은 적을 쓰러뜨리기 힘들 때 유용해. 공격이 더 강해지거든, 간단하지.
Dearly Departed#060.speaker: Farmer Cevalus
